style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Sending the Seventy-Two
images.concept: Sent as lambs among wolves — into the harvest that belongs to God, not to us
images.imageAlt: A vast golden field of unharvested grain extending to the horizon, no workers visible, light raking across it in late afternoon
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a vast unharvested grain field extending from the immediate foreground to the flat horizon, the grain heads bending slightly in the same direction under late afternoon raking light that turns them warm gold against a pale washed-out sky, the field completely empty of any workers or tools, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the sky, muted warm palette of bleached gold and pale blue-white sky, the abundance without workers — the harvest waiting for those who will go, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Return of the Seventy-Two
images.concept: Names written in heaven — the greater joy beneath the visible triumph
images.imageAlt: A worn stone tablet half-buried in earth, its surface smooth and blank, morning light across it
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a piece of pale worn stone partially embedded in dry earth, its upper surface smooth as if worn by handling or exposure, the surface blank — no text, no marks — just the smooth pale stone and its suggestion of something recorded and preserved, soft diffused morning light falling evenly across the surface, the surrounding earth dark and granular, heavy film grain in the earth, muted palette of pale stone and dark soil, the smooth blank surface as the register that outlasts all visible achievement, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Jesus Rejoices in the Spirit
images.concept: Hidden from the wise, revealed to the little ones — the Father's delight in disclosure
images.imageAlt: Warm sunlight breaking through dense overcast and striking a single small wildflower growing from a crack in stone
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, warm sunlight suddenly breaking through dense overcast sky and striking a single tiny wildflower growing from a crack in rough stone pavement, the flower overexposed in the light while everything around it remains in cool overcast gray, the flower's smallness in the vast stone surface emphasized, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the gray surrounding areas, muted palette with only the lit flower carrying warmth, revelation breaking through to the overlooked — the Father's selective disclosure, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Good Samaritan
images.concept: The neighbor you never expected — compassion crossing every boundary to reach the one left for dead
images.imageAlt: An empty stone road passing through a rocky hillside, a torn piece of cloth on the road's edge in evening light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, an ancient stone road cutting through a rocky hillside, the road empty in the evening light, a single torn piece of cloth or garment lying at the road's edge catching the last warm light of evening while the hillside falls into shadow, the road continuing around a bend into shadow, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the shadow areas, muted warm palette of pale stone and fading amber light, the empty road and the abandoned cloth — the passed-by made visible, Kinfolk magazine aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Mary and Martha
images.concept: One thing is necessary — the better part chosen in stillness while activity surrounds it
images.imageAlt: Two spaces on a worn stone floor separated by light: one with scattered grain and a grinding stone, one simply empty in warm light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead view of a worn stone floor divided by a diagonal shadow line, on one side scattered grain and a rough stone grinding tool suggesting busy preparation, on the other side a small empty area of pale stone floor in warm light with nothing on it — just the clean stone and the light, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the shadow areas, muted warm palette, the contrast between activity and presence is the entire theological content, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
